verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal app, not a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or any agent-integration interface. The probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both returned 404, so there is no documented capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
